records.title: Allotment of New Petrol Pumps in Uttar Pradesh.
details: a to e: PSU OMCs have related advertisement in June & July, 2023 for selection of RO dealers across the country including Uttar Pradesh. Under the said advertisement, Letter of Intent (LOI) has been issued in respect of 3,534 ROs in Uttar Pradesh out of which 558 ROs have been commissioned as on 01.03.2025
